name: @filament/openclaw-filament-fcm
description: OpenClaw plugin that connects an agent to Filament via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) pushes and the Filament MCP-over-HTTP agents API.

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts src/fcm.ts src/token-store.ts src/conformance-core.ts src/conformance-http.ts src/mcp-client.ts src/connect.ts src/onboarding-core.ts src/spike-channel.ts --outdir=dist --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --sourcemap
scripts.test: esbuild src/conformance-core.test.ts src/onboarding-core.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist-test --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test dist-test/conformance-core.test.mjs dist-test/onboarding-core.test.mjs
